The '''Platoon Attack Craft (PAC)''', also known as the '''Trade Federation troop carrier''', was a [[repulsorcraft]] personnel [[carrier]] used by the [[Trade Federation]] to transport [[B1-series battle droid]]s.

==Characteristics==
An unarmed variant of the [[Multi-Troop Transport]], or MTT, the platoon attack craft boasted no weaponry or heavy armor and had to rely on [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I|Armored Assault Tanks]] and [[battle droid]]s for protection. It was deployed behind the protection of ground armor in secure conditions, or within occupied territory. Although the MTTs offered greater protection, the troop carrier was faster and more agile, and many were still retained in the [[Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army|Droid Army]].<ref name="Episode I" />

The troop carrier was a [[repulsorcraft]], and similar to the deployment racks used in MTTs,<ref name="Episode I" /> the troop carrier's single rack could carry a number of [[droid]]s folded into their smaller configuration.<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:PACs.png|thumb|300px|left|In order to bring complete subjection to Naboo, the Trade Federation brought their droid army in full force.]]
During the [[Invasion of Naboo]], several platoon attack craft were brought to [[Naboo]] along with MTTs and AATs in [[C-9979 landing craft]]s. The troop carriers were part of the Trade Federation invasion force that occupied the capital city [[Theed]].<ref name="Episode I" />

During the [[Clone Wars]], troop carriers were pledged by the Trade Federation to the [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On [[Geonosis]], they transported battle droid platoons from the planet's underground [[Geonosis droid factories|droid factories]] for deployment. Troop carriers brought battle droids into the [[Petranaki Arena]] when [[Mace Windu]]'s [[Jedi]] [[Jedi assault team|strike team]] arrived to rescue [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="CL2016" />

Early into the Clone Wars, troop carriers were brought to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Hissrich]], and used in the [[Hissrich droid army|Hissrich droid unit]], under the command of the droid [[mercenary]] [[AD-W4]]. The vehicles were stationed alongside MTTs and [[Octuptarra tri-droid]]s at the [[Separatist outpost (Hissrich)|Separatist outpost]] on the planet.<ref name="Mace Windu 1">[[Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu 1|''Jedi of the Republic – Mace Windu'' 1]]</ref> Troop carriers were later used in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Episode III" />

The troop carrier bore resemblence to the [[stormtrooper transport]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]] around the [[time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CL2016" />

==Behind the scenes==
The platoon attack craft first appeared in [[1999]] in the episodic film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="Episode I" /> It was later identified as the platoon attack craft in ''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'', a [[2019]] supplement to [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' series of ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' products,<ref name="Rise">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref> and was also identified as the Trade Federation troop carrier in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], published by [[Dorling Kindersley]].<ref name="CL2016" />
